scientific_integrity: An analytic proof accompanies the result. Finite integration checks are corroboration only, not a proof of strict universal inequalities.
scientific_limitations: The global inequality concerns only 1<b/a<sqrt(2); its endpoint constants are limiting cases. The prior Cassini-area quadrature and convex-hull contact geometry are not new. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Sharp normalized area deficit and distinct area/perimeter critical exponents for connected nonconvex Cassini ovals
